actions.description: Send one SCPI query through the client and return the response text

inputs.description: SCPI command text forwarded verbatim; the upstream query appends CRLF and reads one response
inputs.name: command

actions.name: scpi_query

outputs.description: Response text returned by the instrument (decoded and stripped by the upstream query)
outputs.name: response

facts.text: RedPitayaClient is a class for SCPI communication with Red Pitaya hardware over TCP/IP
connect opens an AF_INET/SOCK_STREAM socket, sets is_connected True after connecting, and sets it False and re-raises when the connection fails
send_cmd appends CRLF to the command and sends it as UTF-8 bytes
query sends the command and returns the decoded, stripped response read from the socket
close closes the socket and sets is_connected to False
get_mock_data generates a synthetic sine wave with noise for testing without physical hardware
The README names SCPI over TCP/IP as the protocol and a Mock Mode that simulates signal acquisition without physical hardware

measures.description: True while the TCP connection to the instrument is open
measures.name: connected

safe_state.description: SCPI socket closed; the client cannot send a command after close
